ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_LEGALENTITYCUSTOMER_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer
AS
(

SELECT
CONVERT(VARCHAR,BST.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
,BST.CNAME AS LegalEntityName
,NULL AS LegalEntityNote
,BST.BDATE AS LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
,NULL AS StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,NULL AS CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,NULL AS StateOfLegalEntityResidence
,NULL AS CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
,NULL AS CurrentManagementFirstControlDate
,NULL AS FirstDateOfOperation
,NULL AS StockExchangeName
,NULL AS ListedSecuritySymbol
,NULL AS TaxExemptCertificateStatement
,NULL AS BankruptcyIndicator
,NULL AS SmallBusinessIndicator
,NULL AS ManufacturingIndicator
,NULL AS ForeignOwnedIndicator
,NULL AS DunsNumber
,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
,NULL AS LegalEntityFormId
,NULL AS NaicsNationalIndustryCode
,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
,NULL AS AnzsicClassCode
,NULL AS SectorCode
,NULL AS SMEClassification
,NULL AS ShortName
,NULL AS FormerName
,NULL AS DoingAsBusinessName
,NULL AS KeyContactPersonName
,NULL AS BusinessTypeId
,NULL AS Top20000
,NULL AS PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
,NULL AS PrimaryParentCompany
,NULL AS PrincipleCountryOfOperation
,NULL AS Dosri
,NULL AS DosriTypeId
,NULL AS CorporateSegment
,NULL AS Website
,NULL AS RelatedPartyIndicator
,NULL AS RelatedPartyTypeId
,NULL AS FATCAIndicator
,NULL AS FATCAType
,'SEC' AS SourceCode
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BST.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BST.CLTTYPE = 'C'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LegalEntityName
,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_TGT
AS(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LegalEntityName
,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
WHERE SourceCode = 'SEC'
),

TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
	,[LegalEntityName] = SRC.LegalEntityName
	,[LegalEntityNote] = NULL
	,[LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment] = SRC.LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
	,[StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment] = NULL
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment] = NULL
	,[StateOfLegalEntityResidence] = NULL
	,[CountryOfLegalEntityResidence] = NULL
	,[CurrentManagementFirstControlDate] = NULL
	,[FirstDateOfOperation] = NULL
	,[StockExchangeName] = NULL
	,[ListedSecuritySymbol] = NULL
	,[TaxExemptCertificateStatement] = NULL
	,[BankruptcyIndicator] = NULL
	,[SmallBusinessIndicator] = NULL
	,[ManufacturingIndicator] = NULL
	,[ForeignOwnedIndicator] = NULL
	,[DunsNumber] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetBranch] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetDivision] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetParent] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate] = NULL
	,[LegalEntityFormId] = NULL
	,[NaicsNationalIndustryCode] = NULL
	,[SicIndustryCode] = NULL
	,[AnzsicClassCode] = NULL
	,[SectorCode] = NULL
	,[SMEClassification] = NULL
	,[ShortName] = NULL
	,[FormerName] = NULL
	,[DoingAsBusinessName] = NULL
	,[KeyContactPersonName] = NULL
	,[BusinessTypeId] = NULL
	,[Top20000] = NULL
	,[PrincipalPlaceOfOperation] = NULL
	,[PrimaryParentCompany] = NULL
	,[PrincipleCountryOfOperation] = NULL
	,[Dosri] = NULL
	,[DosriTypeId] = NULL
	,[CorporateSegment] = NULL
	,[Website] = NULL
	,[RelatedPartyIndicator] = NULL
	,[RelatedPartyTypeId] = NULL
	,[FATCAIndicator] = NULL
	,[FATCAType] = NULL
	,[SourceCode] = 'SEC'
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer
(
CustomerId
,LegalEntityName
,LegalEntityNote
,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
,StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,StateOfLegalEntityResidence
,CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
,CurrentManagementFirstControlDate
,FirstDateOfOperation
,StockExchangeName
,ListedSecuritySymbol
,TaxExemptCertificateStatement
,BankruptcyIndicator
,SmallBusinessIndicator
,ManufacturingIndicator
,ForeignOwnedIndicator
,DunsNumber
,DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
,DunBradstreetHeadquarters
,DunBradstreetBranch
,DunBradstreetDivision
,DunBradstreetSubsidiary
,DunBradstreetParent
,DunBradstreetUltimate
,DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
,LegalEntityFormId
,NaicsNationalIndustryCode
,SicIndustryCode
,AnzsicClassCode
,SectorCode
,SMEClassification
,ShortName
,FormerName
,DoingAsBusinessName
,KeyContactPersonName
,BusinessTypeId
,Top20000
,PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
,PrimaryParentCompany
,PrincipleCountryOfOperation
,Dosri
,DosriTypeId
,CorporateSegment
,Website
,RelatedPartyIndicator
,RelatedPartyTypeId
,FATCAIndicator
,FATCAType
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CustomerId
,LegalEntityName
,NULL AS LegalEntityNote
,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment
,NULL AS StateOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,NULL AS CountryOfLegalEntityEstablishment
,NULL AS StateOfLegalEntityResidence
,NULL AS CountryOfLegalEntityResidence
,NULL AS CurrentManagementFirstControlDate
,NULL AS FirstDateOfOperation
,NULL AS StockExchangeName
,NULL AS ListedSecuritySymbol
,NULL AS TaxExemptCertificateStatement
,NULL AS BankruptcyIndicator
,NULL AS SmallBusinessIndicator
,NULL AS ManufacturingIndicator
,NULL AS ForeignOwnedIndicator
,NULL AS DunsNumber
,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
,NULL AS LegalEntityFormId
,NULL AS NaicsNationalIndustryCode
,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
,NULL AS AnzsicClassCode
,NULL AS SectorCode
,NULL AS SMEClassification
,NULL AS ShortName
,NULL AS FormerName
,NULL AS DoingAsBusinessName
,NULL AS KeyContactPersonName
,NULL AS BusinessTypeId
,NULL AS Top20000
,NULL AS PrincipalPlaceOfOperation
,NULL AS PrimaryParentCompany
,NULL AS PrincipleCountryOfOperation
,NULL AS Dosri
,NULL AS DosriTypeId
,NULL AS CorporateSegment
,NULL AS Website
,NULL AS RelatedPartyIndicator
,NULL AS RelatedPartyTypeId
,NULL AS FATCAIndicator
,NULL AS FATCAType
,'SEC' AS SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityCustomer_DELTA;

END
GO
